name: ValueMate
long_description:
Property appraisals suck — September’s new federal rules will make them even worse.

ValueMate’s LiDAR-plus-AI app captures a property in a three-minute walkthrough and delivers a regulator-ready report on our dashboard, slashing cycle times by 80% for the valuation firms already on board.

In the next few months, every bank, AMC, and independent appraiser must switch to the new format or watch loans pile up. ValueMate handles the transition end-to-end, with zero tape measures, zero data entry, and zero closing delay.

We’re transforming the multi-billion dollar appraisal industry with technology that captures millions of 3D data points per walkthrough.

launches.body:
# **The Problem**

Every time a home is sold, refinanced, or undergoes any transaction, multiple parties, including the government, use appraisals. This is a tedious process, as anyone who’s had an appraisal done knows. It can take days end-to-end and weeks to turn around. It will only get worse when Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac enforce longer reports and more detail come September, blowing up the appraisal industry. Not with ValueMate.

https://youtu.be/-2y0tZhtPHY

**ValueMate**

We’ve built software to take a LiDAR scan of a property with a phone, generate a 3D model and 2D floor plan on-the-fly, take audio-and-video notes on the walkthrough, then immediately draft up a near-final version of the appraisal report waiting for the appraiser back at the office. From inspection to report in minutes, bringing turnaround times from days and weeks to hours. Here’s a testimony from a customer:

> _ValueMate completely transformed our workflow — I honestly can’t believe how much faster we’re working. No more wasted hours on templates, data entry, or switching between tools. It’s unreal. Our reports are cleaner, our data’s accurate, and we’re already set for UAD 3.6. If you’re not using ValueMate ASAP, you’re going to get left behind — especially with the new regulations coming._

\- Nick Conteduca, CSO | Banks Valuation

# **Team**

Anir and Pietro are best friends from Carnegie Mellon, where they studied AI together.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90760&key=user_uploads/2487902/0006365e-6505-4d8b-b030-112b07c6c4c5)

# **TL;DR**

**⏱️ From days to a scan:** ValueMate enables appraisers to significantly increase daily inspections, reducing turnaround times from days and weeks to hours. We’re the only company revolutionizing the entire appraisal lifecycle with AI, end-to-end.

**📅 Regulatory Tailwind:** The upcoming UAD 3.6 standard, mandated by Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac for all new appraisals, requires more detailed and standardized reporting, creating a pressing need for compliant solutions.

**💼 Enterprise Adoption:** Valuation firms are already leveraging ValueMate to enhance efficiency and ensure compliance with upcoming standards.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90760&key=user_uploads/2487902/99c755ff-8cae-42b5-b1a1-7025bb97b19f)

# **Ask**

**If you know anyone who’s a lender, works with a valuation firm, or deals with appraisals, we’d love to get in touch.** We can set them up with a future-proof solution that will significantly speed up their workflow.

**Reach us at [founders@valuemate.ai](mailto:founders@valuemate.ai)**
